decides: 画面取自哪片动画土壤、哪个制作年代——决定线条习惯、上色逻辑与放映质感。这是全球地图层：先定坐标，再谈风格
note: 本维度是风格的地域与年代坐标，与 styles（完成效果）叠加使用；实体与关系见 entities.json（参考层，不进提示词）

items.prompt: retro 1970s Japanese super-robot animation aesthetic, flat hand-painted poster skies, heavy uniform ink outlines, simplified primary color plating with visible panel gaps, coarse 16mm film grain
items.note: 有限动画 + 海报级背景，机体敦实方正

items.prompt: golden-age 1980s Japanese cel animation aesthetic, opaque poster-color background art with real atmospheric depth, characters in crisp two-tone cel shading over it, photographic cel grain and gentle specular bloom
items.note: 水粉背景 × 赛璐璐角色的叠合是年代签名

items.prompt: 1990s Japanese OVA late-night animation aesthetic, high-contrast shadowy key frames, meticulously detailed mechanical and architectural linework, deep saturated palette, restrained bloom on highlights
items.note: 深夜档作画张力：细节密度与暗部控制

items.prompt: early 2000s transitional anime aesthetic, uniform digital lineart and flat cel shading on characters against hybrid matte-painted backgrounds, soft glow bloom across every highlight, mild composite edge aliasing
items.note: 胶片感退场、锐利登场的交界质感

items.prompt: modern high-definition Japanese TV anime aesthetic, razor-clean digital lineart, two-layer shadow separation, luminous gradient hair and eye highlights, 16:9 broadcast framing with subtle grain

items.zh: 日本 · 独立艺术动画
items.prompt: Japanese independent art animation aesthetic, hand-cam paper and pencil textures, experimental watercolor or pastel fields, deliberate line wobble, quiet unconventional framing
items.note: 作者性优先，拒绝工业光鲜

items.zh: 北美 · 黄金时代橡胶管
items.prompt: 1930s American rubber-hose cartoon aesthetic, endlessly bendable pie-cut limbs, white gloves, pie eyes, bouncy squash-and-stretch timing poses, thick even ink outlines on flat watercolor grounds
items.note: 程式化弯曲而轮廓不断线

items.zh: 北美 · 90年代动画电影复兴
items.prompt: 1990s American animated feature renaissance aesthetic, lush painted backgrounds with strong atmospheric depth, expressive broad-shouldered character designs, sweeping musical staging, warm classic palette
items.note: 手绘背景 + 表演驱动构图

items.prompt: modern western television cartoon aesthetic, bold graphic shapes, thick clean outlines, bright saturated flat colors with geometric shadow shapes, snappy comic staging built for 11-minute beats
adult western animation aesthetic, semi-realistic proportions with worn lived-in faces, muted desaturated palette, deadpan sitcom staging, flat lighting with minimal stylization
items.note: 反卡通化：真实比例与生活疲态

items.zh: 中国 · 上美影水墨胶片
items.prompt: Shanghai Animation Film Studio ink-wash tradition aesthetic, brush-painted figures on xuan paper, water-ink bleeding edges, opera-inspired gesture and facial pattern, single warm seal accent
items.note: 水墨、剪纸、戏曲身段的胶片年代

items.prompt: 1990s Chinese television animation aesthetic, clean heroic linework, mythic costume design with opera silhouettes, opaque gouache coloring, warm primary palette with gold trim
items.note: 电视系列黄金年代的美术片底子

items.zh: 中国 · 当代网络番剧
items.prompt: contemporary Chinese donghua web-series aesthetic, immortal-cultivator costume with flowing silk ribbons, fine calligraphic linework, celadon and vermilion scheme with gold ink accents, vertical composition with generous sky
items.note: 国漫 2D 主流：仙侠 + 水墨影响

items.zh: 中国 · 三维动画电影
items.prompt: contemporary Chinese 3D CG animated feature aesthetic, subsurface-scattered stylized skin, physically based silk and armor materials, volumetric cloud and mist, cinematic slow orbiting camera
items.note: 国产 3D 电影级：次表面 + 体积光

items.prompt: Korean webtoon vertical-scroll aesthetic, fashion-realistic proportions, flawlessly airbrushed skin with almost no hard edges, dozens of eye highlight shapes, contemporary street fashion, background dissolved into gradient fog
items.note: 竖屏优先，一切元素避开侧边距

items.prompt: Franco-Belgian bandes dessinées aesthetic, clear-line uniform outlines, flat poster colors with no modeling, meticulous architectural draftsmanship, generous white gutters and panel discipline
items.note: 清晰线条派：人物简、环境繁

items.zh: 苏联东欧 · 手绘胶片
items.prompt: Soviet and Eastern European hand-drawn animation aesthetic, gouache and oil painted directly on glass, soft smeared edges, multiplane foreground layers, Slavic folk ornament inside natural forms, cold palette with one warm accent
items.note: 玻璃上的油画：缓慢、庄严、童话感

items.prompt: global game cinematic CG aesthetic, semi-realistic stylized characters in photographic worlds, rim-lit dramatic key art, particle effects and atmospheric haze, 16:9 or wider cinematic framing
items.note: 动画与游戏美术的杂交地带
